Source: `submodules/arXiv-1809.07267/`

Adams et al. (2019) — the foundational LFRic paper describing the design and motivation of the LFRic infrastructure.

The LaTeX source (`LFRic.tex`) is maintained in this submodule. Key figures include:

- `Fig1_Cubed_Sphere.png` — the cubed-sphere mesh
- `Fig3_PSyKAl.pdf` — PSyKAl separation of concerns
- `Fig4_FieldClass.pdf` — field class hierarchy
- `Fig5_psyclone_flow.pdf` — PSyclone transformation flow
- `Fig7_scale-eps-converted-to.pdf` / `Fig8a_strong_scale.pdf` — scaling results

## Citation

```
Adams, S. V., et al. (2019). LFRic: Meeting the challenges of scalability and
performance portability in Weather and Climate models.
Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing.
arXiv:1809.07267
```
